objective: Preserve hard-to-reconstruct independently trained weights against uncertain future distribution restrictions, without mistaking speculative regulation for current law; minimize redundant files and preserve license, code and dependencies.
method: All active records with parameter_gate.status UNVERIFIED_BLOCK_FINAL_LOCK; inspect model identity, publisher metadata, existing parameter evidence, learned components and overlap. No tensor checkpoint downloaded/executed.

dispositions.reason: Retain research candidate for distinct fine-tuned video/audio weights; must census all DiT+text+VAE+audio dependencies; compare Stuubs and base; avoid three near-duplicates.
Separate fine-tune provenance; verify OmniNFT merge lineage and video/audio objective vs ChrisColeTech; choose only if unique measurable behavior.
Distinct twelve-control acoustic style is a unique axis; publisher 9.6M is only main model; enumerate vocoder/refiner/flow/WavLM/MiniLM; gated NC rights.
Distinct Indic-language TTS; 2.5024B main does not count Mimi/ECAPA; verify separate learned components and licenses.
35.8996B main only; FP8+BF16 original and all codec/MTP dependencies required; no misleading inference from INT4 duplicate.
Small trained adapter and potentially unique editing objective; exact immutable Qwen-Image-2.1 base, tokenizer/text encoder/VAE must be mapped and shared not double-counted.
33.123B transformer alone; learned 4B text encoder, prompt upsampler and decoder; license other; no acquisition without complete components and terms.
Two separately trained classifier/regressor .pt heads; bytes are not parameter counts. Check source .pt shapes and parent TabICL dependence, avoid saving same parent twice.
Publisher ~8M and SDK 2.44M disagree; inspect checkpoint tensor keys/shapes and dependencies, pin one immutable weight when same SHA.

priorities.first: Resolve 9 active pipeline parameter gates, especially small adapter and independent specialized TTS / Kumo
priorities.second: Pin source revisions, selected tensor files and SHA256, codec/encoder/VAE dependencies and licenses for all 144 active
priorities.third: Use actual disk inventory and deduplicated content-addressed byte union to decide replacement; do not use repo display bytes as selected scope
priorities.fourth: Consider XiaomiRobotics/Xiaomi-Robotics-U0-4B only after compare to Cosmos3/Wan learned objectives and selected bytes; previous seven-candidate proposal remains non-executable

legal_forecast_separation.fact: Hugging Face gated models and license restrictions are current repository properties; present-day universal open-weight ban not established here.
legal_forecast_separation.scenario: Broadening restrictions on high-capability and/or open-weight models is a stress-test assumption, not a measured probability.
legal_forecast_separation.operational_rule: No circumvention of gated authorization, license terms, or distribution rights.

limitations: Hub publisher metadata is not a full tensor census
No physical storage or runtime validation
Exa unavailable with HTTP 402 credit exhaustion
No final selection transition performed without evidence
